{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Jiexiu Chongguang power station''' (山西国际能源介休崇光低热值煤电厂) is an operating power station of at least 700-megawatts (MW) in Yian Town, Jiexiu, Jinzhong, Shanxi, China.
It is also known as Jiexiu Gangue power station.

==Background on Project==

Jiexiu Chongguang power station is a proposed 2 x 350 MW waste coal-fired power plant in Shanxi Province.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1qdCpv3 "山西首定五个低热值煤发电项目"], 人民网, 2013-11-18</ref> In 2015 the power station was under construction.<ref>[http://www.zbyyts.net/show/31764.html "介休 低热值煤发电项目正式开工建设,"] 2015-08-31</ref>

==Project suspended, then revived==

===July 2017: Plant postponed by government===
In July 2017 China's National Energy Administration (NEA) postponed or halted 185 coal-burning units across 21 provinces, totaling nearly 107 gigawatts (GW). 114 coal units totaling 65 GW are postponed for consideration until after the end of the 13th 5-year plan, in 2020. In addition, 71 coal units totaling nearly 42 GW were halted indefinitely for regulation violations. NEA said its goal is to eventually suspend or halt 150 GW of coal capacity during the 13th 5-year plan (2016-2020).<ref name=july17>[https://www.sohu.com/a/161854870_651522 "16部委联合发文防范化解煤电产能过剩风险,"] Sohu.com, 2017-08-03</ref>

Jiexiu Chongguang power station Units 1-2 are among the postponed coal-burning units.<ref name=july17>[https://www.sohu.com/a/161854870_651522 "16部委联合发文防范化解煤电产能过剩风险,"] Sohu.com, 2017-08-03</ref>

For more information, see [[China's 2016/2017 Restrictions on Development of Coal-Fired Power Capacity]].

===September 2017: Suspension lifted===
After political negotiations, China's National Energy Administration (NEA) released an updated list of postponed and halted coal projects on September 26, 2017. The new list contained 151 units totaling 95 gigawatts (GW). Jiexiu Chongguang power station was no longer on the list, suggesting the plant is not suspended.<ref>[https://www.sohu.com/a/197969653_279604 "2017年分省煤电停建和缓建项目名单,"] Sohu, 2017-10-12</ref>

In early 2018 it was reported the plant is planned for commissioning in late 2018.<ref>[http://www.cnpowerbid.com/news/show-49555.html "山西崇光发电有限责任公司介休2×35万千瓦低热值煤发电新建项目劳务综合服务招标公告,"] CN Power, 2018-02-26</ref>

==2020-2021: Plant commissioned==

Unit 1 was commissioned in December 2020.<ref>[ "介休2×35万千瓦低热值煤发电新建项目1号机组一次通过168小时试运行,"] 中国火力发电网, 2021-01-04</ref> Unit 2 was commissioned in February 2021.<ref>[http://www.chinaepi.org.cn/show.asp?id=250728 "中国能建设计承建山西介休低热值煤发电新建项目建成投产,"] 2021-02-08</ref>
